item.title: Bengal STF probe Jaish man's plot to create trouble at Jantar Mantar
item.description: West Bengal Police STF arrested Arpita Sarkar, girlfriend of suspected terrorist Hamim Mondal. Investigators are probing their alleged plan to create disturbances at Jantar Mantar. Hamim was reportedly working under instructions from Pakistani handlers via social media. Arpita is also suspected of involvement in a honey-trap network targeting influential people. The investigation is ongoing, and more arrests are anticipated in the coming days.
item.dc:creator: TAMAGHNA BANERJEE AND MOHAMMAD ASIF

item.title: India-China border trade resumes after 6 years
item.description: India and China have reopened two key Himalayan trade routes after six years. Traditional border trade resumed Saturday through Lipulekh and Shipki La passes. Chinese authorities restricted the initial batch of traders to twenty people. Indian traders can export 36 categories of goods, while Chinese traders bring twenty. A new trade mart was also inaugurated near the international border.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: India win seven gold medals to cap record-breaking boxing campaign in CWG
item.description: India finished on top of the boxing medal standings with seven gold and three silver medals, registering its best-ever performance at the Commonwealth Games.
item.dc:creator: TOI SPORTS DESK

item.title: 'Prepare to depart': US embassies issue alert across Middle East amid Iran tensions
item.description: US embassies in Middle East urged citizens to depart due to potential conflict escalation. The security alerts warned of unpredictable Iranian actions and possible attacks on US interests. President Trump threatened Iran with severe military action following alleged truce violations. Iran warned countries supporting the US against facing war's flames. Regional shipping and travel face disruptions amid ongoing hostilities and heightened tensions.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Nuclear plants, Gaza craters: Google pulls AI tool from Google Earth in 24 hours
item.description: Google has removed its new AI image generation feature from Google Earth. This action followed immediate concerns raised by researchers about disinformation risks. Experts warned the tool could easily create convincing fake satellite imagery for public deception. Google stated they are implementing stronger safeguards while pausing the feature. The company noted generated images were watermarked as AI-created.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Happy Friendship Day 2026: 50 wishes, messages and quotes to share
item.description: Friendship Day 2026 falls on Sunday, August 2, celebrating connections. The article offers fifty wishes and quotes for expressing appreciation. These messages cater to heartfelt, funny, and short sentiments for friends. It also includes specific wishes for childhood and long-distance friendships. Famous quotes about friendship are provided for sharing with loved ones.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: NEET-PG 2026 gets major overhaul: Centres closer to home, single-shift exam, fewer questions
item.description: NEET-PG exam sees significant changes for candidate convenience and enhanced security. Candidates now select three preferred states for their examination centre locations. The exam duration remains the same, but questions reduce to 180 for more time. Aadhaar and iris biometrics strengthen registration and exam day security measures. NEET-PG 2026 will be conducted in a single shift for uniform assessment.
item.dc:creator: KARAN MANRAL

item.title: 6 killed in Kerala as heavy rain triggers landslides, floods; IMD issues red alert
item.description: Heavy rains lashed Kerala on Saturday, causing landslides and widespread flooding. Six people died in rain-related incidents, with several others rescued from affected areas. Authorities launched large-scale rescue and evacuation operations, setting up numerous relief camps for displaced residents. Landslides and flooding disrupted traffic and damaged many houses across several districts. The India Meteorological Department issued red and orange alerts for multiple districts forecasting heavy rainfall.
item.dc:creator: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI

item.title: When a district in Florida's Everglades used robot rabbits to eliminate Burmese pythons
item.description: Florida is employing AI-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons. These solar-powered decoys mimic prey using heat and scent to lure snakes. When a python is detected, officials are alerted to remove the invasive species. This technology complements the annual Python Challenge, which has removed thousands of snakes. These efforts aim to control the python population impacting native wildlife.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: RTI activist seeks probe into Dipke's father's finances; flags Rs 1cr CJP defence fund
item.description: An RTI activist has requested an inquiry into the finances of CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke's father. He also wrote to authorities regarding Kapil Sibal's announced legal defence fund. The activist questioned the unregistered CJP's operation as a political party. He asked the Election Commission to verify the CJP's registration status. The activist also asked GST authorities to check tax on Sibal's pledged amount.
item.dc:creator: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI

item.title: Singapore student vanishes after Cambodia flight ticket is found
item.description: A Singaporean student, Siti Aishah Siregar, disappeared after telling her family she was going to college. Her family discovered her passport missing and a flight ticket to Cambodia in her email. Singapore police confirmed the 20-year-old had already departed the country on an outbound flight. Her father issued an emotional appeal on Facebook for assistance to locate his daughter.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Ghana capital turns plastic waste into cheaper street paving
item.description: Ghana is pioneering a sustainable solution to its plastic pollution crisis by turning waste into economical paving blocks for highways. Led by entrepreneur Nelson Boateng at Nelplast, the initiative compensates plastic collectors, significantly benefiting the community. The resulting paving blocks are not only resilient but also priced competitively against concrete, effectively tackling environmental challenges while providing financial opportunities for many.
item.dc:creator: TOI SCIENCE DESK

item.title: World's largest digital camera captures more than 500,000 galaxies in deep view of universe
item.description: The Vera C. Rubin Observatory has released a stunning image of the COSMOS field. This image contains over half a million galaxies and fifty thousand stars. Astronomers have studied this specific sky region for over two decades. The observatory's new camera provides unparalleled depth and coverage of the universe. Future observations will reveal even fainter galaxies and cosmic events.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: 'Screams, sudden death': 16-year-old girl's body exhumed 52 days after burial in UP
item.description: A 16-year-old girl's body was exhumed fifty-two days after her burial in Aligarh. Suspicious circumstances surrounding her death prompted the district administration to order a fresh investigation. A local resident alleged hearing screams and later learned of the girl's sudden death. Following his complaint and death threat claims, authorities ordered the exhumation for examination. The body has now been sent for a post-mortem as police begin their detailed inquiry.
item.dc:creator: RK LAXMI

item.title: 'Girls' clothes torn, heads broken': CJP demands PM's apology over police action
item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: How to get John Wick Sprite in Fortnite: Location, ability, and more
item.description: Fortnite's new v41.30 update brings the John Wick Sprite exclusively to Reload mode. Players can find this Sprite in normal and special Sprite chests within the game. Eliminating opponents who possess the Sprite also allows for its acquisition by other players. Winning a Victory Royale in Reload mode guarantees the John Wick Sprite for all participants. This Sprite reveals nearby enemies for a short duration after an elimination.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Brittany Mahomes shares powerful message on motherhood after $325M success
item.description: Kansas City Chiefs star Patrick Mahomes' wife, Brittany Mahomes, shared a heartfelt message about motherhood, leadership and the next generation while celebrating another major milestone beyond football. The Kansas City Current co-owner reflected on why she wants her children to see women in leadership as the norm after helping build one of the biggest success stories in women's sports. Here's what Brittany said during her speech, why she was honored, Patrick Mahomes' loving reaction, and how her impact continues to shape opportunities for women on and off the field
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Michael Jordan’s high school setback that inspired his legendary NBA career
item.description: Michael Jordan's famous quote emphasizes accepting failure while not accepting inaction. He believed that learning from mistakes is crucial for personal growth and development. Jordan's own career demonstrated this philosophy through numerous setbacks and comebacks. This mindset continues to inspire individuals across various fields and endeavors. The core message highlights the value of effort over the fear of potential failure.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: 'Disappointed with PM Modi': Shehzad Poonawalla’s sarcastic 'dictator' jibe at oppn
item.description: Taking a jibe at PM Modi's critics, Shehzad Poonawalla expressed "disappointment" with Prime Minister Narendra Modi's leadership style. He sarcastically suggested Modi learn dictatorship from past Congress leaders. Poonawalla cited Indira Gandhi and Jawaharlal Nehru as examples of strong rule. He also mentioned past Congress governments' actions during protests. The former spokesperson concluded Modi had not met Left-liberal expectations.
item.dc:creator: KARAN MANRAL

item.title: 'Weaker, stronger, peter out': Mixed messages complicate Trump's Iran exit plan
item.description: US President Trump is receiving conflicting advice from two key regional allies on how to handle Iran. Saudi Arabia is urging restraint and de-escalation to prevent a wider regional conflict, while Israel is pressing for a tougher stance against Tehran. Meanwhile, tensions continue to rise, with attacks on commercial shipping and drone strikes in Kuwait adding to regional instability. Trump has expressed frustration over stalled diplomatic efforts and Iran's refusal to meet US demands.
item.dc:creator: VIVEK DUBEY

item.title: Gold rush: Arundhati Choudhary wins India's fifth boxing gold at CWG 2026
item.description: Arundhati defeated Reid by a unanimous 5-0 decision to give India its fifth boxing gold of the competition.
item.dc:creator: TOI SPORTS DESK

item.description: However, Vinoth told TOI that the document in his possession was only the “budget preface and not the complete budget document.”

item.title: Watch: Pro-Channi sloganeering draws Congress' ire amid Punjab leadership tussle
item.description: Congress internal rifts in Punjab persist as Charanjit Singh Channi supporters disrupted party programs. Bhupesh Baghel warned of expulsion for indiscipline, emphasizing unity for upcoming elections. The party high command will decide the chief ministerial face after the Punjab Assembly polls. Baghel stressed strengthening the party at the booth level for electoral success. Warring highlighted the need for a strong organizational structure over individual popularity.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Bernard Arnault mocks Le Monde probe: LVMH chief posts sarcastic X rebuttal
item.description: Bernard Arnault sarcastically addressed a Le Monde investigation into his family and business empire. He dismissed claims of family succession rifts and political influence. The billionaire questioned the newspaper's extensive resources dedicated to the six-part series. Arnault also defended his family's interactions and LVMH's business-first strategy.
item.dc:creator: ARUSHI JAIN

item.title: Vijay’s son Jason Sanjay says father urged him to create his own identity
item.description: Jason Sanjay, son of actor-turned-politician and Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay, has opened up about his father's historic election victory, his directorial debut, and the constant public scrutiny surrounding their family. Jason, who recently made his directorial debut with Sigma, spoke candidly about the responsibility that comes with being part of Vijay's family.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: Delhi teen raped multiple times by friend; case comes to light after her pregnancy
item.description: A 17-year-old girl from Delhi has accused her friend of multiple rapes in a Gurugram hotel. The alleged incidents occurred between January and March 2026, police stated. A case was registered after the teenager became pregnant and was medically examined. The FIR was filed under POCSO and Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita sections. Police are investigating and conducting raids to apprehend the accused.
item.dc:creator: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI

item.title: 'Sexually explicit language': Complaint over Insta video targeting Rahul Gandhi
item.description: A KPCC Legal Cell member filed a police complaint regarding an Instagram post. The post contained defamatory and objectionable content targeting Rahul Gandhi. Several users also posted abusive and sexually explicit comments on the video. Police registered a case under the IT Act and BNS for investigation. Measures are being taken to delete the video and trace the account administrator.
item.dc:creator: H M CHAITHANYA SWAMY

item.title: 3 Gold, 2 Silver, 2 Bronze: Indian para athletes script history in Glasgow
item.description: India's para athletes achieved their finest-ever performance at the 2026 Commonwealth Games. They secured seven medals, matching all previous editions combined in a single campaign. Para athletics led the success, contributing six medals including three gold and two silvers. Indian athletes achieved multiple one-two finishes in several track and field events. This historic showing marks a significant leap forward for Indian para sports.
item.dc:creator: TOI SPORTS DESK

item.title: DMK moves SC seeking immediate release of Cauvery water to Tamil Nadu
item.description: The DMK has petitioned the Supreme Court for immediate Cauvery water release from Karnataka. Karnataka's government faces a directive to release 3,500 cusecs daily for fifteen days. The plea also seeks to clear an accumulated water release shortfall of 9.46 TMC. Karnataka's Chief Minister urged protesters to withdraw their agitation against water releases. The state government will protect farmers' interests while respecting judicial orders.
item.dc:creator: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: UPI reaches new milestone with highest-ever transaction value of Rs 29.88 lakh crore
item.description: India's UPI platform achieved its highest monthly transaction value ever. In July, transaction volumes also reached a new record high. The platform processed billions of transactions, surpassing previous records. This sustained growth strengthens India's digital payment ecosystem significantly. UPI is also expanding its global footprint across several countries.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: Fire breaks out at judicial magistrate's office in Bihar; records reduced to ashes
item.description: A significant fire erupted at the Judicial Magistrate First Class office on Saturday morning. The blaze destroyed numerous important case files and legal records before court proceedings began. Firefighting teams battled for hours to bring the flames under control after the incident. Officials are now assessing the extensive damage and investigating the fire's cause. Hearings scheduled for Saturday have been postponed due to the fire.
item.dc:creator: FARYAL RUMI

item.title: 'Kept motivating me': Jadumani Singh credits Sarita Devi for his CWG silver medal journey
item.description: Jadumani Singh Mandengbam secured a silver medal at the Commonwealth Games. He credited veteran boxer Sarita Devi for her significant support and guidance. Sarita Devi's daily advice and encouragement were crucial to his journey. The young boxer aims to improve and perform well in future competitions. This silver medal will motivate him to work even harder.
item.dc:creator: TOI SPORTS DESK

item.title: 'Go that way': Illegal migrants say Moroccan authorities directed them towards Ceuta
item.description: Moroccan illegal migrants reported encouragement from authorities and social media messages. Thousands crossed into Spain's Ceuta enclave, with many returning due to hardship. At least sixty-seven people died during the unprecedented border crossing event. Spain is reinforcing the Ceuta border after tens of thousands entered. The crisis has sparked political tensions and renewed migration policy debates.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: 2,000-pound US bomb hits Iran family home; Centcom says 'we never target civilians'
item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: Indian equities ‘probably oversold’: FIIs warm up after months of outflows
item.description: Foreign investors are showing renewed interest in Indian equities after significant outflows. Geopolitical uncertainties and elevated oil prices continue to pose risks to the outlook. India's domestic economy demonstrates robust performance with healthy sales and credit growth. The Reserve Bank of India is expected to align its monetary policy with the US Federal Reserve. Delays in bond index inclusion reflect global market dynamics, not India's debt concerns.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: Bengal to clear all pending CAA applications within six months, says Suvendu Adhikari
item.description: West Bengal's Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari pledged to resolve all pending CAA applications soon. He stated the law grants citizenship and is not meant to revoke it. Nearly twenty-four thousand citizenship certificates have already been issued to eligible refugees. The government will delegate powers to district magistrates for faster application processing. This initiative aims to provide citizenship to persecuted minorities from neighboring countries.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Build within 5 years or lose your govt-allotted plot: Karnataka CM DK Shivakumar
item.description: The Karnataka government is set to reclaim plots that have not seen any construction within five years. Beneficiaries will be reimbursed their payments along with accrued interest. This initiative seeks to tackle the issue of abandoned sites turning into dumping grounds. The government encourages property owners to develop their plots, particularly those allotted by BDA, CITB, and cooperative societies.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Bengal CM, Jantar Mantar protest: SIT reveals arrested JeM operative's target list
item.description: An alleged Jaish-e-Mohammed operative was arrested by West Bengal STF. Hamim Mondal planned to target Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari and disrupt a Delhi protest. He intended to disguise himself in a police uniform for sabotage activities. Mondal was in contact with Pakistan-based handlers through encrypted messaging applications. The investigation is ongoing to uncover the full extent of the terror network.
item.dc:creator: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI

item.title: Video shows inferno after Russian missile barrage leaves 9 dead in Ukraine
item.description: Russia launched a fresh wave of missile and drone strikes across Ukraine. These attacks killed at least nine people and injured more than thirty others. Kyiv and surrounding regions were targeted in the second major aerial assault in two days. Ukrainian authorities reported 27 ballistic missiles were fired, with only one intercepted. President Zelensky renewed urgent calls for more Western air defence systems.
item.dc:creator: VIVEK DUBEY

item.title: Rs 32 crore, boardroom feud, contract killers: How chairman plotted MD’s murder
item.description: A financial dispute over thirty-two crore rupees allegedly led to a murder conspiracy. GSM Foils chairman Sagar Bhanusali is accused of hiring contract killers to eliminate his partner. He allegedly failed to repay the large sum owed after selling his company stake. Financial losses in stock markets reportedly pushed the chairman into debt. Police arrested seven individuals, including the alleged shooter, in connection with the plot.
item.dc:creator: RK LAXMI

item.title: 'Dump her body in canal': Man dies by suicide after telling kin he killed wife on vc
item.description: A villager allegedly murdered his wife and then committed suicide. He made a video call to relatives claiming the murder before his death. The wife, Gagana, is currently missing and a search is underway. Police registered a missing complaint and are investigating the incident. The couple had been married for thirteen years and had two sons.
item.dc:creator: RANJITH KANDYA

item.title: Samudra Manthan explained: How India’s offshore oil push can be a game-changer
item.description: The Samudra Manthan – National Offshore Exploration Scheme aims to unlock India’s offshore oil and gas potential. This will be done through large-scale seismic surveys, deepwater exploration, scientific drilling.
item.dc:creator: SMRITI JAIN
